answers.purpose: Authors and verifies Mermaid diagrams in Markdown files and standalone .mmd files, rendering each to confirm it parses before a doc ships.

triggers.disambiguation: Not /init (which scaffolds CLAUDE.md). Owns Mermaid syntax and render correctness only: label wording, jargon and acronym-on-first-use belong to editorial, which this skill hands off to and is handed off from. Not for LikeC4 .c4 models, which have their own validate and export commands.
